lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Wall A to wall B corner fold, about 90 deg. Sections at 25/50/75% put the cross on the outer-skin apex of the V (nearest point 0.03-0.11 mm). The line runs about z -20.7..25.8 between the top and bottom lip folds, which is the whole visible corner.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Wall A's outward top lip, about 90 deg. The apex sits on the outer skin in every section (0.03-0.12 mm). The close-up shows the lip running exactly over the line's span, and presence checks stop within 1 mm of both ends.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Wall A's outward bottom lip, about 90 deg, one fold running through the embossed hole bosses. The apex is on the outer skin (0.02-0.13 mm). The lip ends at about t=88 and the line reaches 87.5. Past that, only the wall edge remains (relief notches), with no lip.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Wall A's inward top tab, about 90 deg. The apex is on the outer skin (0.08-0.17 mm). The tab looks about 16-17.5 mm wide face-on and the line is 15.9 mm, so coverage is at least 90%.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: End return tab at the far end of wall A, about 90 deg, roughly 11 mm wide (z -9..2). The apex is on the outer skin (0.13-0.17 mm). The tab's hole boss shows up in the sections but does not move the apex.

lines.label: B6
lines.reason: Wall B's outward top lip, about 90 deg, x -16..11. The apex is on the outer skin (0.01-0.06 mm), and the lip covers exactly the line's span.

lines.label: B7
lines.reason: Wall B's inward top lip, about 90 deg, x 11.6..54.5. The apex is on the outer skin (0.03-0.18 mm). Beyond the line end only wall B's stepped top edge remains, with no lip. The boss shows in the 75% section but the fold is unaffected.

lines.label: B8
lines.reason: Wall B's outward bottom lip, about 90 deg, one fold through the bosses, x -16..47. The apex is on the outer skin (0.01-0.11 mm). From x 47 to 57 there is no lip, only the wall edge, so it correctly stops before the lanced tab.

lines.label: B9
lines.reason: First bend of the joggle (about 50 deg), from wall B into the S-ramp of the lanced end tab at x 57..68. Sections at x=60/65 and at 25/50/75% put the cross on the convex outer (-y) skin at about z -15.8 (0.04-0.21 mm). The line covers the full tab width from the lance slit to the part edge.

lines.label: B10
lines.reason: Second bend of the joggle (about 50 deg), from the S-ramp into the offset tab, which sits about 3 mm inward. The cross is on the convex (+y) outer skin at about z -18.3 (0.04-0.09 mm). It spans the same full tab width as B9.
